text: Let S be the set of all ternary strings defined over the alphabet {a, b, c}. Consider all strings in S that contain at least one occurrence of two consecutive symbols, that is, 'aa', 'bb' or 'cc'. The number of such strings of length 5 that are possible is ______.
solution: Count the complement. Total strings 3^5 = 243. A string avoids all three patterns exactly when each symbol differs from its predecessor: 3 x 2^4 = 48. Answer 243 - 48 = 195. Adding the three pattern counts directly would double count strings such as 'aabbc'.
source_label: GATE CSE 2025 Set 1 Q.30 solution stating official answer 195 (also iaeacademy.in, citing the IIT Roorkee key)
